newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli commandos raid Lebanon Hizbollah targets.
newsitem.headline: Israeli commandos raid Lebanon Hizbollah targets.

text.p: Israeli commandos in helicopters backed by warplanes raided suspected pro-Iranian Hizbollah targets early on Monday, residents said.

Heavy clashes lasting about two hours erupted between Israeli forces and Hizbollah (Party of God) fighters at Kfour in Nabatiyeh outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone after the helicopters struck.
Security sources and residents said five Hizbollah guerrillas were later killed by three roadside bombs planted by the Israeli commandos.
Residents said Hizbollah had closed off the battle area and a Hizbollah spokesman in Beirut said he had no immediate details on casualties.
In Jerusalem, an army statement said "a number of terrorists" were injured while all of the Israeli troops returned home safely.
It said an army force acted north of the zone in an area around Nabatiyeh where it encountered and fought "a terrorist group" before returning.
Hizbollah guerrillas are fighting to oust Israeli forces and their local militia allies from the 15-km (nine-mile) border zone.
